newsitem.title: DENMARK: Superfos takes over U.S. asphalt firm.
newsitem.headline: Superfos takes over U.S. asphalt firm.

text.p: Danish construction, chemicals and packaging group Superfos A/S said on Tuesday its Superfos Construction U.S. unit acquired with immediate effect U.S. road construction firm Gainesville Asphalt.

Gainesville Asphalt, based in Gainesville, Georgia, has an annual turnover of some $9 million, with 35 employees producing approximately 220,000 tonnes of asphalt annually, mainly for the public sector, Superfos said.
Superfos Construction U.S. also operates in four other states with a total turnover of $250 million last year.
Superfos said the acquisition was part of its strategy to strengthen its position in its U.S. markets.
